scope: Transparent evaluator and diagnostic changes; no participant-source repair

changes.detail: T2 skips redundant Clear only after confirming already-empty query and All status; the first9/10 result and corrected10/10 result are both retained.
T3 final evaluation includes real CDP touchCancel and committed touch drag in addition to mouse movement, settle and dismissal. Every T3 output uses the same implementation.

Runtime and Chromium paths may be overridden with UI_EVAL_RUNTIME and UI_EVAL_CHROMIUM. Defaults and all acceptance assertions are unchanged. First three evaluations used the identical default paths before this path-only change.
A separate non-scoring asset/network diagnostic compares ordinary loading with external requests blocked. This does not change functional acceptance or visual ratings.
